task.text: That was my mistake: GPIO3 came from my original ESP32 design. Use GPIO5 for 5V_EN instead. I also realized that GPIO22, GPIO23, GPIO25, and GPIO27 are not exposed on the WROOM-1 module, so SCL0 must move from GPIO22 to GPIO38 and SPI MOSI from GPIO23 to GPIO26. I'll update the documentation and send you the complete revised GPIO table.
